Table 1. Global growth has moderated
Note: Difference from June 2026 OECD Economic Outlook in percentage points, based on rounded figures. World and G20 aggregates use
moving nominal GDP weights at purchasing power parities (PPPs). Revisions to PPP estimates affect the differences in the aggregates. Based
on data available up to 16 September 2026.
1. The European Union is a full member of the G20, but the G20 aggregate only includes countries that are also members in their own right.
2. Spain is a permanent invitee to the G20.
3. Fiscal years, starting in April.
Source: OECD Interim Economic Outlook 120 database; and OECD Economic Outlook 119 database.
